summary: Markets are broadly risk-off: Bitcoin and global equities are under pressure as hawkish Federal Reserve expectations lift the dollar and yields, while gold sits near a 14-month low.[1][2] Oil is comparatively firm near $92 per barrel because attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz offset concerns about a coming surplus.[1][5] Same-day source coverage available here does not verify fresh calls from the named crypto influencers, so unverified analyst-specific altcoin signals are excluded.
